Build with purpose.

Ata Turhan founded Solarity AI with a focus on AI-powered products. Today, that direction brings four self-improvement apps together with three web apps for the teams who build them.

The company welcomes investors and collaborators interested in consumer software, product distribution, and systems for the teams creating mobile experiences.

How we work

Broad ambition.
Specific choices.

  1. Give every product a clear purpose.

    Begin with a defined audience and a useful place in everyday life. Let that purpose guide what belongs in the experience.

  2. Make the next useful action clear.

    Treat design as part of how the product works. Clarity and consistency matter as much as visual character.

  3. Reuse the work. Keep the judgment.

    Develop workflows that may serve more than one product, while preserving the decisions each audience and problem needs.
